ADJUST: BLUR (JOV): Soften a picture with a box, stack, Gaussian or median blur
ADJUST: COLOR (JOV): Shift a picture's three colour channels in RGB, HSV, YUV, LAB, LUV or XYZ space
ADJUST: EDGE (JOV): Find the edges in a picture with Canny, Sobel, Laplacian, Prewitt, Scharr or a morphological outline
ADJUST: EMBOSS (JOV): Turn a picture into a raised relief lit from one direction
ADJUST: LEVELS (JOV): Set a picture's black point, midtone and white point by hand, or stretch each channel so its darkest pixel becomes black and its brightest white
ADJUST: LIGHT (JOV): Tonal adjustments applied in order: brightness, contrast, histogram equalisation, exposure and gamma
ADJUST: MORPHOLOGY (JOV): Grow, shrink, open or close the shapes in a picture or mask
ADJUST: PIXEL (JOV): Pixel-level effects: pixelate into blocks, rescale for a retro look, reduce to fewer colours, or posterise into bands
ADJUST: SHARPEN (JOV): Sharpen a picture with an unsharp mask
AKASHIC (JOV) 📓: Show anything wired into its growing inputs as text on the node: numbers, text, lists, and the shape of pictures, masks and latents
ARRAY (JOV) 📚: Gather everything wired into its growing inputs, batches split into frames, into one list, then keep all of it, one entry, a slice, chosen indices or a random sample
BATCH TO LIST (JOV): Turn a batch of pictures, masks or latents, or a Python list, into a list, so the next node runs once per entry instead of once for the batch
BIT SPLIT (JOV) ⭄: Split a number or text into its separate bits, least significant first, as 0 and 1 and as booleans
BLEND (JOV) ⚗️: Layer a foreground over a background with one of thirty blend modes, such as multiply, screen or overlay, through an optional mask
COLOR BLIND (JOV) 👁‍🗨: Show how a picture looks to someone with red, green or blue colour blindness
COLOR MATCH (JOV) 💞: Recolour a picture to match a target picture's palette, or map its tones through a built-in colour map
COLOR MEANS (JOV) 〰️: Find a picture's most used colours and hand them on as swatches, a tonal palette, a gradient and a 3D LUT
COLOR THEORY (JOV) 🛞: Build a colour harmony, such as complementary, triadic or analogous, from a picture's average colour
COMPARISON (JOV) 🕵🏽: Compare A with B, component by component, and pass on 'success' when every component passes or 'fail' otherwise
CONSTANT (JOV) 🟪: Make a solid colour picture of any size, or place a picture over a colour through its alpha or a mask
CROP (JOV) ✂️: Cut a region out of a picture: a centred window, a window at a position, or any four-cornered shape
DELAY (JOV) ✋🏽: Pause the run for a set time, then pass its input on
EXPORT (JOV) 📽: Save a batch of pictures as numbered PNG or JPG files, or as one animated GIF, into ComfyUI's output folder or a folder below it
FILTER MASK (JOV) 🤿: Make a mask from the pixels close to one colour, or between two colours
FLATTEN (JOV) ⬇️: Add every picture wired into its growing image inputs, and every frame of each batch, into one picture
GRADIENT MAP (JOV) 🇲🇺: Recolour a picture by its brightness: dark tones take the gradient's left colour and bright tones its right
GRAPH (JOV) 📈: Plot the numbers wired into its growing inputs as lines that grow with every run
HISTOGRAM (JOV): Draw a picture's brightness histogram: how many pixels sit at each level from black on the left to white on the right
IMAGE INFO (JOV) 📚: Read a picture's batch count, width, height and channel count, singly and as vectors
LERP (JOV) 🔰: Blend between two numbers or vectors by a factor, per component
OP BINARY (JOV) 🌟: Combine two numbers, vectors or pictures with arithmetic, minimum and maximum, dot and cross products, bitwise logic or set operations
OP UNARY (JOV) 🎲: Apply a one-input function to a number, vector or picture: absolute value, rounding, roots, trigonometry, logic, or a summary such as mean, median or length
PIXEL MERGE (JOV) 🫂: Build a picture from separate red, green, blue and alpha planes, filling any missing plane from a base picture or the matte
PIXEL SPLIT (JOV) 💔: Split a picture into its red, green, blue and alpha channels as masks, plus its RGB
PIXEL SWAP (JOV) 🔃: Build a picture whose red, green, blue and alpha each come from any channel of picture A, picture B or a constant
QUEUE (JOV) 🗃: Step through a list of values, files or folders, one entry per run
QUEUE TOO (JOV) 🗃: Step through a list of pictures, one per run, handing each on as RGBA, RGB and mask, optionally resized
ROUTE (JOV) 🚌: Pass up to ten values of any type through one node, each to the output beside its input
SAVE OUTPUT (JOV) 💾: Save pictures as PNG files with a name you choose, carrying the workflow and any extra metadata you add, into ComfyUI's output folder or a folder below it
SHAPE GEN (JOV) ✨: Draw a circle, square or regular polygon of any size, position, angle and softness
SPLIT (JOV) 🎭: Cut a picture in two at a chosen point, top and bottom or left and right
STACK (JOV) ➕: Place every picture wired into its growing image inputs, and every frame of each batch, in a row, a column or a grid
STRINGER (JOV) 🪀: Split, join, filter, replace or slice the text wired into its growing string inputs
SWIZZLE (JOV) 😵: Build a new vector whose X, Y, Z and W each come from any component of vector A, vector B or a constant
TEXT GEN (JOV) 📝: Render text into a picture with any installed font, aligned, justified, rotated and optionally sized to fit
THRESHOLD (JOV) 📉: Cut a picture into light and dark at a threshold, either one level for the whole picture or one adapted to each neighbourhood
TICK (JOV) ⏱: Generate a list of frame values from a start and a step, with optional looping and ping-pong, plus normalised and eased copies
TRANSFORM (JOV) 🏝️: Move, rotate, scale, tile and mirror a picture, then optionally project it through a perspective, sphere, fisheye or polar warp
VALUE (JOV) 🧬: Supply a boolean, integer, float or vector, typed in or converted from whatever is wired in, with its components on separate outputs
VECTOR2 (JOV): Build a two component float vector, such as a size or a position, from typed values or wired numbers
VECTOR3 (JOV): Build a three component float vector, such as an RGB colour or a 3D position, from typed values or wired numbers
VECTOR4 (JOV): Build a four component float vector, such as an RGBA colour or a rectangle, from typed values or wired numbers
WAVE GEN (JOV) 🌊: Sample a sine, square, sawtooth, noise or other waveform at a point in time, as a float and an integer
